title: Private deploy field notes - Acme Corp (VPC / on-prem)
content:
Purpose:
Quick field notes and running checklist for Acme Corp private deployment (VPC + on-prem gateway). Meant as my personal scratchpad during install window and follow-ups. Not finalized; share relevant sections to Confluence and KB after changes confirmed.

High-level customer constraints:
- Acme wants outbound-restricted VPC with NAT only via corporate proxy. No direct internet egress from inference cluster.
- Hardware: 2 x rtx-a5000 nodes for inference, 1 x mgmt vm (4 vCPUs, 16GB) for control plane.
- KMS: customer uses AWS KMS in their account; keys must be configured and test encrypt/decrypt before handoff.
- Network: /22 CIDR for private subnets; customer requires static IP whitelist for control plane callbacks (we provided 3 IPs).

Pre-install checklist (things to confirm before running scripts):
- [ ] Confirm firewall rule acceptance (ticket JIRA-4217 updated 2024-09-11).
- [ ] Customer VPN / DirectConnect stability check (ops reported intermittent flaps last week).
- [x] AGREE roles and SSH users (ops-rlz, deploy-bot).
- [x] Confirmed KMS ARN and created service principal for key usage.
- [ ] Validate that proxy allows TLS passthrough to our registry (they block all except internal artifactory) — if blocked, we need to mirror images to their registry.

Quick install commands (local run on mgmt vm) — copy these when running:
- Prep host:
  sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y docker.io jq curl
- Configure docker to use customer proxy (example):
  sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d
  echo "[Service]\nEnvironment='HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp.local:3128'\nEnvironment='HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp.local:3128'\n" | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d/http-proxy.conf
  sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart docker
- Pull images (if allowed). If not, use provided mirror: mirror.acme.corp/redwood/*
- Run install script (dry-run first):
  ./deploy/scripts/install.sh --dry-run --config ./deploy/acme-config.yaml

Blockers observed so far:
- Registry access blocked: customer proxy returned 403 for docker pulls. Action: escalate to customer infra to add allowlist for mirror.acme.corp or grant outbound to ghcr.io.
- KMS IAM role mapping: the AWS account used by their infra team didn't include kms:Decrypt on the key for the deploy-bot principal. Working with their security (ticket created).
- SELinux on one node set to enforcing and causing kubelet failures (node: infra-node-02). Workaround: set to permissive until we install correct policy. Note: remind SRE to revert and add policy.

Configuration gotchas / reminders:
- Our control-plane webhook callbacks must use the provided static IPs; double-check that the customer reversed proxy routes 443 -> internal mgmt vm when testing webhooks.
- Metrics export: customer requires all Prometheus endpoints to be on internal only. Ensure no metrics endpoint exposed on public NIC.
- Disk layout: inference nodes have NVMe mounted at /mnt/nvme0; our config expects /var/lib/redwood/cache -> bind to /mnt/nvme0/cache. Add to deploy config.
- GPU drivers: vendor driver version tested = 525.60.11. If they have newer drivers, run smoke tests (nvidia-smi, simple perf run).

Validation checklist (post-install):
- [ ] Model load smoke test: load gpt-2-small variant and run 1k tokens across 10 concurrent requests 
- [ ] KV cache persistence test: restart runtime and ensure cached prefixes reload (use test prompt set acme-smoke-v1).
- [ ] Latency SLO sample: p95 < 120ms on small prompts (test harness: /deploy/test/run_latency.sh).
- [ ] Billing metrics: ensure token counters propagate to control plane via the internal collector.

Notes to follow up with customer:
- Ask infra to provide pattern for DOH/proxy allowlist for our image registry mirrors.
- Confirm maintenance window for kernel upgrades (we might need to reboot GPUs).
- Request SSH key for ops user rotate schedule and confirm emergency access process.

Open questions / TODOs for me:
- Rework install.sh to support mirrored registries via env var MIRROR_REGISTRY (quick patch planned).
- Create a small Confluence KB: "Private deploy common gotchas (VPC/proxy/KMS)" and paste merged notes.
- Coordinate with SRE for SELinux policies for kubelet + nvidia drivers.

Short log of actions (timestamped):
- 2024-09-12 09:15 - initial scoping call with Acme infra (notes in slack thread).
- 2024-09-13 16:02 - validated KMS ARN, customer to add kms:Decrypt for service principal.
- 2024-09-15 11:40 - attempted dry-run install, blocked on docker pulls (403).
- 2024-09-16 10:05 - created JIRA-4217 for registry allowlist follow-up.

Snippets to paste elsewhere:
- Error seen on docker pull through proxy:
  "HTTP code 403: Forbidden" -> show to customer infra and ask to check proxy ACLs for mirror.acme.corp and ghcr.io
- kubelet journal tail (node infra-node-02):
  Sep 15 11:12:03 infra-node-02 kubelet[1234]: Failed to start cni plugin: permission denied -> SELinux audit logs show avc denials.

If anything urgent happens during install window ping: @riley (Slack) and call pager if node unresponsive.

End of scratchpad. Will refine and move stable notes to Confluence after next successful run.
